description: Review the user's answer to an interview question: a rating, length and speaking time, STAR coverage for stories, filler words, specific checks, the follow-up an interviewer would likely ask, and a stronger version that keeps to the user's own facts. Part of the answer is drafted by an AI model (Gemma 4, with Llama 3.3 70B as a backup, on Cloudflare Workers AI) behind ATSPrep's guard, which drops any figure, name or tool the user's text doesn't contain. If the AI part is unavailable, the rule-based part still comes back and ai.message says why.

answer.description: The user's answer, as they would say it.

kind.description: story (default: a past example, scored on STAR), pitch (tell me about yourself), plan (how would you…), number (salary or a figure) or close (questions for them).

resume_text.description: Optional. The resume, so the stronger answer can use real facts from it.

name: review_interview_answer
title: Review an interview answer
